P, K = map(int, input().split())
parent = list(range(P + 1))
rank = [1] * (P + 1)

def findp(x):
    while parent[x] != x:
        parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]
        x = parent[x]
    return x

def union_sets(a, b):
    if rank[a] >= rank[b]:
        parent[b] = a
        rank[a] += 1
    else:
        parent[a] = b
        rank[b] += 1

for i in range(1, P + 1):
    val = (K * i) % P
    pa = findp(i)
    pb = findp(val)
    if pa != pb:
        union_sets(pa, pb)

groupSet = set()
for i in range(1, P + 1):
    groupSet.add(findp(i))

MOD = 1000000007

def fast_pow(base, exp, mod):
    res = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = (res * base) % mod
        base = (base * base) % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return res

if K == 0:
    ways = fast_pow(P, P - 1, MOD)
elif K == 1:
    ways = fast_pow(P, P, MOD)
else:
    ways = fast_pow(P, len(groupSet), MOD)

print(ways)
